conceptual_change: Implement a deterministic volatility-gate mechanism that restricts entry signal execution to market conditions where the 14-period ATR exceeds 1.5 times the 20-period moving average of the ATR.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis (BTC_1h_007) was rejected due to lack of an explicit engine implementation. This hypothesis formalizes the requirement into a deterministic logic gate to be executed by the engine to filter low-volatility regimes.
